evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $60.801B, up 28% YoY; DAP 3.60B; ad impressions +14%; average price per ad +12%; Q2 OCF $31.862B; reported FCF $0.784B; 2026 capex guidance $130-145B.
H1 2026 revenue $117.111B; H1 ad revenue $114.387B; H1 OCF $64.088B; PPE purchases $49.113B; finance lease principal $1.805B; SBC $13.690B.

June cash plus marketable securities $90.26B; debt principal $84B; non-cancelable contractual commitments $349.31B; not-yet-commenced leases $278.99B; July added about $68B of data-center leases; contingent cloud-capacity obligations up to $14.72B; restricted cash equivalents $10.80B.
Reality Labs Q2 revenue $431M; H1 revenue $833M. FY2025 Reality Labs operating loss was $19.193B.
FY2025 revenue $200.966B, net income $60.458B, OCF $115.800B, PPE $69.691B, finance-lease principal $2.524B and SBC $20.427B.
No customer represented 10% or more of FY2025 revenue or accounts receivable; 37% of revenue came from marketers/developers based in the United States.
EY expressed unqualified opinions on FY2025 financial statements and ICFR; management concluded ICFR effective.

As of July 24, 2026, 2.205128509B Class A and 0.342377716B Class B shares were outstanding. No Class A shares were repurchased in H1 2026. At June 30, 146.464M RSUs were unvested and 436M Class A shares were reserved for future issuance under the equity plan.

Meta's August 2026 bipartisan state-AG agreement has an approximately $18B payment framework over ten years and Meta expects an approximately $10B Q3 2026 legal charge; prior Q2 guidance otherwise remained unchanged.

Meta launched Muse on September 8, 2026, a consumer AI agent available through a dedicated app or WhatsApp with free and paid tiers; Reuters reported unresolved security/reliability risks from internal testing.

TTM = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025 gives revenue $228.247B, net income $68.098B, OCF $130.301B, PPE $89.325B, finance-lease principal $3.104B, reported-style FCF $37.872B, SBC $25.136B and FCF-minus-SBC diagnostic $12.736B.
At $646.49 and 2.547506225B shares, simple market cap is about $1.647T; market-cap/TTM net income ~24.2x; market-cap/reported-style FCF ~43.5x; market-cap/FCF-minus-SBC diagnostic ~129.3x.

9% hurdle DCF gives Bear/Base/Bull approximately $217.45/$668.73/$1,312.26. Holding Base year-1 revenue $250B, 10%-to-20% owner-cash margin path and 20x terminal multiple requires about 12.53% annual revenue growth in years 2-10 to match $646.49.
